description: Expand the API route's catch block to also return the user-friendly 503 message when RIOT_API_KEY is missing (status 500 with message containing 'RIOT_API_KEY'). Currently, only 401/403 from Riot API are caught, but when the env var is not set at all, the RiotApiError(500, 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured') falls through to the generic handler and leaks internal details to users. The GitHub Issue #21 already exists with correct content and the 'urgent' label. No new issue creation is needed.
steps: Run npm install in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker to set up dependencies

In app/api/riot/route.ts, expand the if condition at line 201 from `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)` to also catch the missing-key scenario: `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403 || (error.status === 500 && error.message.includes('RIOT_API_KEY')))`
Run npm run lint to verify zero lint errors
Run npm run build to verify zero build errors
Create a new git branch named 'fix/api-key-expired-handling' (do NOT reuse any existing branch)
Commit the change with message 'fix: return user-friendly 503 when RIOT_API_KEY is missing'
Do NOT push or create a PR - the orchestrator handles that
acceptance_criteria: The condition in app/api/riot/route.ts catches 401, 403, and 500-with-RIOT_API_KEY-message errors
All three cases return HTTP 503 with body { error: 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later', status: 503 }
npm run lint passes with zero errors
npm run build passes with zero errors
Changes are committed on a new branch 'fix/api-key-expired-handling'
findings: Implementation completed successfully. Review feedback addressed: (1) Added 'code' property to RiotApiError class with options-object constructor pattern, using error.code === 'MISSING_API_KEY' instead of fragile string matching on error.message. (2) Reverted unrelated package-lock.json changes (recharts). bun run lint and bun run build both pass with zero errors. Commit amended on branch fix/api-key-expired-handling-v2 at commit 9ac2bcf.
